title: minedeepseekchat
description:
为 Minecraft 玩家提供实时 deepseekAI 助手，解答游戏问题
Provides Minecraft players with a real-time deepseek AI assistant to answer in-game questions
body:
用途：为 Minecraft 玩家提供实时 AI 助手，解答游戏问题（如攻略、合成表、彩蛋）。
使用：聊天栏输入 d + 空格 + 问题（例：d 如何快速找到钻石），AI 将私信回复答案。
注意：需在配置文件填入 DeepSeek API 密钥[https://platform.deepseek.com/]
Purpose: Provides Minecraft players with a real-time AI assistant to answer in-game questions (e.g., guides, recipes, secrets).
Usage: Type d + space + question in chat (e.g., d How to find diamonds fast). The AI will reply privately.
Note: Add your DeepSeek API key in the config file [[https://platform.deepseek.com/]
